title: Performance and overall driving impressions
summary: Reviews in this topic center on broad praise for the G70’s performance, handling, power, comfort, and design, with a few complaints about comparisons to prior luxury cars and an overly complicated owner's manual.

positive.summary: Positive reviews praise the engine, performance, handling, power, suspension, and overall enjoyment of the vehicle.

negative.summary: Negative reviews focus on the car feeling worse than a previous luxury sedan and on the owner's manual being overly complicated.

undetermined.summary: Undetermined fragments mention favorable-sounding driving, speed, comfort, luxury, size, and design impressions, but the sampled text is too incomplete or ambiguously coded to summarize more confidently.

limitations: Many sampled fragments are generic or incomplete customer-remark statements, which limits specificity.
The topic mixes broad overall impressions with specific aspects such as engine performance, seats, design, and the owner's manual.
A large share of the sampled fragments is labeled undetermined, so the sentiment picture is only partially clear.
Examples are limited to the supplied fragments and are not representative estimates of all G70 reviews.
